Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: one inline landscape painting for Kanji Trail A Bookshop for One Day, after paragraph 0.
Input images: Kasa Jizō image is approved inline simplicity reference. Bookshop cover is Nao identity and palette only, not its rich texture or later book-reading scene.
Show Nao taking her place behind the counter of her grandfather's small secondhand bookshop on its last morning. She stands with hands resting lightly on the counter, looking thoughtfully toward the open entrance. Young Japanese woman with dark hair in a loose bun, ivory blouse and muted teal apron, matching cover. Simple natural face and proportions. A few stacks of closed books and broad shelf shapes establish the shop. Soft morning light through wooden doorway, quiet bittersweet mood.
Broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, just a few purposeful folds and shadows. Three quiet depth layers, simplified shelves with plain colour book spines. Warm ivory, teal, ochre wood and terracotta accents. Full bleed 12:7 landscape, Nao large and clearly readable.
Opening setup only: no pencilled note, open book, future visitors or resolution. Omit closure sign to keep image text-free. No lettering, readable book titles, captions, borders or watermark. Avoid dense shelving detail, paper grain, cover-level brush texture, photorealism and glossy 3D.

Use case: illustration-story.

Scene/backdrop: A small contemporary secondhand bookshop in a Japanese neighborhood on a rainy afternoon. Simple warm-wood shelves and the open entrance with soft rain outside; no readable signs.
Subject: Nao stands behind the counter, matching the cover's young Japanese woman with dark hair in a loose bun, ivory blouse and muted teal apron. Opposite her, an adult Japanese woman in a modest blue coat with rain-damp sleeves has just come in. Both look toward the same thin, closed ship-adventure book with a bent corner on the counter; their expressions are quietly thoughtful as the visitor recognizes it.
Style/medium: hand-painted children's-book gouache with broad smooth colour areas, gentle contours, minimal surface texture, few purposeful folds and shadows, and restrained facial detail. Keep details simpler than the cover and shelves largely as quiet shapes.
Composition/framing: full-bleed wide landscape, approximately 12:7 for the existing inline reader; medium-wide counter-level view, Nao and the visitor clearly readable at small size, book visible between them.
Lighting/mood: cool rain outside and soft warm shop light inside; a gentle, private moment of recognition.
Color palette: warm ivory, muted teal, sage, ochre wood, and subdued blue; cover informs Nao's identity and palette only.
Constraints: depict only the meeting described in paragraph 3. Keep the book closed and its cover blank apart from a simple non-text ship motif if visible. No letters, legible book titles, signage, captions, borders, watermark, melodrama or cover-level texture.
